findings.evidence: CanonicalSchoolClient.client.lua creates a fresh submissionId inside every choice-button activation, but pending progression retries require the exact original submissionId. After progression_commit_failed, a second tap therefore receives progression_pending instead of retrying the durable commit.
findings.exitCriterion: Retain and reuse the original submissionId while a completed class is progression-pending; clear it only after durable applied/duplicate progression or explicit terminal reset. Add deterministic regression coverage.

findings.evidence: Client points initialize to 0 and update only from submit responses containing progressionState; GetClassState exposes ephemeral class completion state, not persisted progression. A rejoined player cannot directly observe that the prior committed result was restored.
findings.exitCriterion: Expose a read-only persisted progression snapshot (or equivalent server-authoritative restored result) to the playable client and demonstrate it after rejoin. Studio-memory fallback must not be represented as production cross-server persistence.
